C-R2-UPLOAD-FEEDBACK-320.IntentSummary: Reuse the existing upload APIs and processing states, changing only presentation and batch accounting so the UI never reports success before the server confirms each file.

T-001.Title: kafedra-design: define honest compact upload states

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Uploading, saved/processing, ready, needs-review and failed use short Russian labels without modal confirmation.
Desktop and mobile use the same state meanings and keep the existing compact geometry; only wrapping may differ.

T-002.Title: kafedra-motion: use no-motion for upload feedback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No animation is added; existing live progress text remains the feedback surface.
prefers-reduced-motion behavior remains unchanged because this feature introduces no motion dependency.

T-003.Title: kafedra-feature: account for each HTTP upload result

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Generic upload and protocol import count server-confirmed success/error independently and continue after a failed file.

T-004.Title: kafedra-design-audit: verify primary work stays available

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Good files remain visible immediately, failed file text is local to that row, and no extra step is introduced.
Desktop and mobile retain keyboard/focus behavior and the same primary actions while feedback remains inline.

T-005.Title: kafedra-tests: cover mixed success and state wording

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: One saved and one failed item render a truthful summary; uploading is never described as already saved.
